description: This file contains functions for building prompts related to heartbeat and cron events, detecting heartbeat acknowledgment and noise events, and classifying system events as cron reminders within a system that manages scheduled events and heartbeat signals.

methods.name: buildCronEventPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a prompt message for cron events based on pending events and options.

methods.name: buildExecEventPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a prompt message for the completion of asynchronous commands.

methods.name: isHeartbeatAckEvent
methods.description: Detects if an event string is a heartbeat acknowledgment event.

methods.name: isHeartbeatNoiseEvent
methods.description: Detects if an event string is heartbeat-related noise, including acknowledgment and poll/wake events.

methods.name: isExecCompletionEvent
methods.description: Checks if an event string indicates execution completion.

methods.name: isCronSystemEvent
methods.description: Determines if a system event should be treated as a real cron reminder, filtering out heartbeat noise and execution completion events.
